notes: Added API exposure, testing, and integration coverage for Specialty Identification.

change_log.note: Expose specialty identification through application layer
Ensure correctness of specialty mapping logic
Connect specialty output to downstream provider search

stories.title: Expose Specialty Identification via FindCare Facade
stories.description: Integrate specialty identification into the FindCare facade, enabling tool_router to invoke the capability and return NUCC-coded specialties as part of provider search preparation.

stories.title: Unit and Integration Tests for Specialty Identification
stories.description: Develop unit tests for regex, vector, and aggregation stages, plus integration tests validating end-to-end mapping from user query to NUCC codes, including edge cases like ambiguous or multi-specialty queries.

stories.title: Integrate Specialty Output with Provider Search Service
stories.description: Connect specialty identification outputs (NUCC codes and classifications) into provider_search_service to drive taxonomy fallback and improve provider retrieval accuracy.
